guidetextdraw_copy._value: INSTRUCTIONS: We need to confirm that a member of your family will be enrolled in college at least half-time during the 2022-2023 academic year. The family member must be working towards a degree or certificate leading to a recognized educational credential at a college that is eligible to participate in federal student aid programs. Please have that person sign and submit this form to his/her financial aid office for completion of the review. If you have more than one family member in college, make a submission of this form for each person. If your family member will not be enrolled in college at least half-time during the 2022-2023 academic year, please check the appropriate box, sign the certification and submit it to the Office of Financial Aid at California State University, Fullerton. Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will delay processing.
